note: Attacker-controlled PDF object graph is traversed; each iteration dereferences the current indirect object pointer.
Resolves the indirect reference; the returned pointer may alias a cached object that is later freed.
Drops the previously cached object, decrementing its refcount and freeing it when it reaches zero.
Loads a fresh object into the cache slot; the old object memory is now freed but the caller still holds a stale pointer.
Returns the stale pointer to the freed object; subsequent dereference in the loop reads/writes freed heap memory.
Dereferences the freed object to check its type, causing the heap-use-after-free access.
